newsitem.title: GERMANY: Gold price may rise on lower S.Africa output - bank.
newsitem.headline: Gold price may rise on lower S.Africa output - bank.

text.p: Weak bullion prices may move higher soon as South African production falls, Germany's WestLB bank said in a market report.
South Africa's gold mining industry faced rising costs and declining ore grades, and work had been disrupted by labour conflicts and communal violence.
The gold market was underpinned at $380 an ounce, the report said, adding a $378-382 price range would attract Far Eastern demand.
Interest in the western world had diminished but was strong in Asia, especially India, the bank said.
Thursday's London morning gold fix was at $382.05.
Platinum was oversold and might also move up in the short term, WestLB said.
The metal was fixed at $387.25 this morning.
